description: State-by-state reference on contractor licensing requirements, exam-prep comparisons, bonding, and insurance.
tagline: Your guide to contractor licensing and requirements.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our editorial team researches and verifies state-level requirements for contractor licensing, exams, and bonding.

editorial.how_we_test: We aggregate and verify licensing requirements directly from state board official documentation and cross-reference exam materials.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We receive referral commissions when you purchase exam-prep courses or bonding/insurance through links on our site.
editorial.corrections: If you find outdated licensing information, please contact us. We review and correct inaccuracies promptly.
